auth.login: POST /api/session (application/x-www-form-urlencoded: username, password; no certlogin field)

auth.redfish: Basic auth accepted for the web admin; POST /redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions -> 201 X-Auth-Token + Location; DELETE -> 204; SessionTimeout 30
